name: Stripe

params.name: status
params.description: draft, open, paid, uncollectible or void

docsDigest: Stripe REST API. Auth: Bearer secret key (sk_live_ or sk_test_ - a test key only ever sees test data, which is the safe way to try this). Request bodies are FORM-ENCODED, not JSON, and nested fields use bracket notation (metadata[order_id]=x); responses are JSON. Lists are cursor paginated with limit plus starting_after. Amounts are integers in the smallest currency unit, so 1000 is 10.00 EUR.
notes: Read-only endpoints on purpose. A Stripe secret key can move money, so this template deliberately does not include charge or refund creation; add those yourself if you mean to.
